import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query to find the nearest DECLARED_MONUMENT to station 14
# Calculate distance from monument centroid to station coordinate
query = text("""
SELECT 
    sa.name,
    ST_Distance(
        ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography,
        aqs.coordinate::geography
    ) as distance_m
FROM sensitive_area sa
CROSS JOIN air_quality_station aqs
WHERE sa.category = 'DECLARED_MONUMENT'
AND aqs.id = 14
ORDER BY distance_m
LIMIT 1
""")

result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)
